project.model_title: ES26-082 Casa 7, Las Brenas, Lanzarote - Quotation Q01

views.title: Foundation ICF
views.desc: Nudura 6in XR35 foundation walls, two courses on the tie beams (-0.715 to +0.200), and the 6in Standard cross wall.

views.title: Pool and plant room
views.desc: One 6in Standard ICF loop with the shared wall T-ing in: the 10.0 x 3.6 m pool (4 courses) and the plant / storage room behind it (6 courses, founded at -2.80); base slabs assumed.

views.title: Ground-floor slab
views.desc: Concrete ground-bearing slab inside the walls, 150 on a 150 sub-base - indicative, the basic design does not specify it.

views.title: Ground-floor ICF
views.desc: Ground-floor walls, seven courses to the first-floor level +3.40, with the 25 mm external overfly on every opening head and jamb.

views.title: First floor
views.desc: One-way joist floor (forjado 30: joists at 700, 250 concrete blocks, 50 topping) with the 300 south slab edge and the 3.0 m north cantilever, screed, and the solarium inverted terrace.

views.title: First-floor ICF
views.desc: First-floor walls to the +7.00 parapet, cantilevering 300 past the ground-floor south wall as drawn, the solarium parapet to +4.30 and the stair wall.

views.title: Roofs
views.desc: Flat roof: forjado 30 with lightweight-concrete falls, membrane, XPS and gravel ballast; plant room deck slab.

views.title: Windows, doors and glazing screens
views.desc: The joinery schedule: timber entrance door, aluminium sliding screens, tilt-turn windows and the 6.16 x 2.80 bedroom 2 glazing screen.

views.title: North elevation
views.desc: Complete structure seen from the north.

views.desc: Complete structure seen from the south.

views.desc: Complete structure seen from the east.
